```{r include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(janitor)
library(reactable)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

here::i_am("projects/race_results.qmd")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
races_raw <- read_excel(here("data/race_results.xlsx"), sheet = 1) %>%
  clean_names()



hms_to_sec <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXct") || inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
    hour(x) * 3600 + minute(x) * 60 + second(x)
  } else if (is.numeric(x)) {
    # raw Excel serial fraction of a day
    round(x * 86400)
  } else {
    period_to_seconds(hms(x))
  }
}

sec_to_clock <- function(s) {
  h <- s %/% 3600
  m <- (s %% 3600) %/% 60
  se <- round(s %% 60)
  ifelse(h > 0,
         sprintf("%d:%02d:%02d", h, m, se),
         sprintf("%d:%02d", m, se))
}
races <- races_raw %>%
  mutate(
    date = as_date(date),
    time_sec = hms_to_sec(time),
    pace_sec = hms_to_sec(per_mile_pace),
    time = sec_to_clock(time_sec),
    per_mile_pace = sec_to_clock(pace_sec),
    overall_pctl = 1 - (overall_rank - 1) / overall_total,
    group_pctl = 1 - (group_rank - 1) / group_total,
    distance_mi = case_when(
      str_detect(distance, "^5K")  ~ 3.107,
      str_detect(distance, "^10K") ~ 6.214,
      str_detect(distance, "Half") ~ 13.11,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)
```


```{r echo=FALSE}
tbl_data <- races |>
  mutate(
    overall = paste0(overall_rank, " / ", overall_total),
    group_rank_disp = paste0(group_rank, " / ", group_total),
    gender_rank_disp = paste0(gender_rank, " / ", gender_total),
    gender_pctl = 1 - (gender_rank - 1) / gender_total,
    overall_pctl_disp = scales::percent(overall_pctl, accuracy = 1),
    group_pctl_disp = scales::percent(group_pctl, accuracy = 1),
    gender_pctl_disp = scales::percent(gender_pctl, accuracy = 1)
  ) |>
  select(name, distance, date, location, time, per_mile_pace,
         overall, overall_pctl_disp,
         group, group_rank_disp, group_pctl_disp,
         gender_rank_disp, gender_pctl_disp,
         shoes, results_link, notes)
```

  Show as percentile
</label>

```{r echo=FALSE}
tbl_data |>
  reactable(
    elementId = "results-table",
    searchable = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 10,
    defaultSorted = "date",
    defaultSortOrder = "desc",
    striped = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      name = colDef(name = "Race", minWidth = 160),
      distance = colDef(name = "Dist.", maxWidth = 80),
      date = colDef(name = "Date", format = colFormat(date = TRUE), maxWidth = 110),
      location = colDef(name = "Location", minWidth = 130),
      time = colDef(name = "Time", maxWidth = 90),
      per_mile_pace = colDef(name = "Pace/mi", maxWidth = 90),
      overall = colDef(name = "Overall Rank", maxWidth = 110),
      overall_pctl_disp = colDef(name = "Overall %ile", maxWidth = 110, show = FALSE),
      group = colDef(name = "Age Group", maxWidth = 100),
      group_rank_disp = colDef(name = "Group Rank", maxWidth = 100),
      group_pctl_disp = colDef(name = "Group %ile", maxWidth = 100, show = FALSE),
      gender_rank_disp = colDef(name = "Gender Rank", maxWidth = 110),
      gender_pctl_disp = colDef(name = "Gender %ile", maxWidth = 110, show = FALSE),
      shoes = colDef(name = "Shoes", minWidth = 130),
      results_link = colDef(
        name = "Results",
        maxWidth = 90,
        cell = function(value) {
          if (is.na(value) || value == "") return("")
          htmltools::a(href = value, target = "_blank", "View →")
        }
      ),
      notes = colDef(name = "Notes", minWidth = 150)
    )
  )
```
